name: Leexi
description:
Leexi connects Claude to your call recording and sales intelligence platform, giving you instant access to every conversation your team has had. Search across calls by keyword, participant, or date, pull AI-generated summaries and full speaker-attributed transcripts, and dig into Leexi's product documentation, all without leaving your chat.

Key features:
- Search calls by topic, customer, date range, or team member
- Get AI summaries of any call — key points, sentiment, and next steps
- Pull full transcripts with speaker attribution and timestamps
- Query product documentation to answer "how does X work" questions
- Surface follow-ups and action items buried in past conversations

Built for sales, CS, and support teams who want their calls to be searchable and actionable, not just recorded.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Leexi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Leexi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.leexi.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Leexi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leexi provides these MCP tools: fetch_call_details, fetch_call_transcript, fetch_resource_details, query_calls, and query_resources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Leexi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Leexi in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Leexi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Leexi is developed by Leexi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
